Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation

Class Effects

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation.Effects
public final class Effects extends Object
Convenience effects backed exclusively by the existing non-overlapping property timeline.

Configures normal property tracks before rendering; it does not create a second clock. Effects on the same property must respect Timeline overlap rules. Pop-in scales around the local origin.
